source.title: ILLEGAL CASINOS INVESTIGATION
source.note: German summary of the Casino Secrets research on Platincasino and the SoftSwiss network. Summaries paraphrase what the video says; they are claims, not findings of this project.

mentions.claim: The estimated German tax loss caused by Platincasino alone since its move offshore in 2023 is put at EUR 250 million.
Platincasino went online in 2013 and grew around 2020 through aggressive marketing; after failing to get a German licence its owner moved it offshore, into a white-label set-up with SoftSwiss.
In this set-up the real founders are said to live in Berlin, a Georgian national is registered as the owner in Curaçao, and companies in Cyprus handle card payments.
mentions.note: The video does not name the Curaçao company; Dama N.V. is the company the register lists with the platincasino.io domain and that other sources link to this set-up.

mentions.claim: From the leaked data, a transaction volume of about EUR 1.8 billion in a single year is attributed to the SoftSwiss network.
Shortly before publication a raid in Frankfurt seized about EUR 80 million and the casino's German owner was arrested.
